Metadata.title: Lunar — A Dynamic Island for Windows 11
Metadata.description: Lunar is a small pill at the top of your screen with a pair of eyes that watch over your desktop. Free, open source, private.

Common.tagline: A Dynamic Island for Windows 11, with a pair of eyes that watch over your desktop.

Footer.copyright: © 2026 Rafael Evan Kristanto. Lunar is free and open source under the Apache License 2.0.
Footer.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with Apple or Anthropic.

system.name: System
system.summary: Clock, volume and brightness, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, and the Translate button

media.name: Media
media.summary: What's playing in any app, with play, pause, previous, next and seeking

pomodoro.name: Pomodoro
pomodoro.summary: A focus timer from 1 to 180 minutes that turns on Do Not Disturb

converter.name: File converter
converter.summary: Convert PNG, JPG and PDF, or turn pictures into a Word document, offline

notes.name: Notes
notes.summary: Quick notes that save as you type, and the voice recorder

usage.name: Usage
usage.summary: Your Claude 5-hour and weekly limits, off until you turn it on

pomodoro.hint: Starting also turns on Do Not Disturb until the time is up.

converter.hint: Pictures and PDFs, converted on this PC

preview.title: Meet the island
preview.lead: Click a page, use the arrows, or switch the style. They are redrawn from Lunar's own panels.
preview.activitiesLead: The closed island shows the music, the recording or the focus timer.

tour.lead: Click the eyes, then swipe or use the arrow keys to move between six pages. Scroll to walk through them here.

Download.notWindows: Lunar is for Windows 11 PCs. Copy the link and open it on your PC.
